program_description: Create an Apple-signature-verified macOS Recovery ISO on Debian. A recovery ISO needs Internet during installation and a compatible OpenCore EFI.
menu_invalid: Choose one of the listed entries, a version, or a macOS name.
recovery_notice: This creates RECOVERY media, not a full offline installer. Apple decides availability and the offered point release; the downloaded version is checked.
stage_download: Download/resume and verify the recovery image
stage_version: Read the actual version from the verified image
stage_verify_iso: Verify the HFS+ payload inside the finished ISO
signature_ok: Apple RSA signature valid. Authenticated image size: {size}.
mount_hint: Attach this ISO as a CD/DVD (media=cdrom), start your compatible OpenCore EFI first, then select Recovery. Both devices must be enabled in the Proxmox boot order.
version_scope: The detected version belongs to the recovery environment. Apple's installer may offer a different point release; the ISO is not a complete offline installation image.
verification_ok: Verified Apple recovery payload: macOS {version}, build {build}. ISO SHA-256: {sha256}
verification_scope: The Apple signature authenticates BaseSystem. It does not sign the locally generated ISO wrapper or your separate OpenCore EFI.
cached_image: Checking the previously downloaded image before reusing it...
range_restart: Apple did not honor the range request. Restarting this temporary download.
download_retry: Download interrupted; preserving verified chunks. Retry {attempt}/{total}.
http_signed_transport: Apple supplied an HTTP recovery-asset URL. Discovery uses HTTPS; the asset is accepted only after Apple's RSA signature and all chunk hashes validate. Use --https-only to reject HTTP assets.
existing_iso: An ISO already exists. Verifying it without overwriting: {path}
fallback_selector: Apple did not provide the requested recovery with this selector. Trying the documented alternative.
local_inputs: Using local image and chunklist; no download request will be made.
probe_ok: Apple returned a digitally signed recovery product. Its macOS version has not been inspected yet.
dry_run: Plan only: request {name}, verify Apple signatures, download into {work}, detect the actual version, then create and verify a Recovery ISO in {output}. No network request or ISO creation performed.
doctor_title: Prerequisites for the recovery ISO builder:
install_prompt: Install the missing Debian packages using apt? [y/N]:
cancelled: Canceled. Resumable downloads are preserved; unfinished output ISO files are removed.
unsafe_file: Refusing a symlink or non-regular output file: {path}
locked: Another process is using this workspace: {path}
unknown_version: Unknown version: {version}. Use --list to see supported families.
unavailable_version: {name} ({version}) has no Apple Internet Recovery selector. An original installation medium is required; this script will not substitute an unverified third-party download.
version_mismatch: Requested family {requested}, but Apple's verified recovery contains {actual}. No ISO was published under the requested name.
exact_mismatch: Requested exact version {requested}, but the recovery contains {actual}. Select the family instead if its available point release is acceptable.
interactive_required: No interactive input is available. Supply --os VERSION, --list, --doctor or --verify ISO.
manifest_unsigned: The chunklist does not contain the supported Apple digital signature. Refusing to continue.
manifest_signature: Apple RSA signature verification failed. Refusing to use this image.
image_size: Image size mismatch: expected {expected} bytes, received {actual}.
image_hash: A recovery-image chunk failed its authenticated hash check. The image cannot be used.
unsafe_url: Apple returned a URL outside the allowed recovery endpoints or an invalid URL.
http_forbidden: HTTP is not permitted for {host} under the selected policy. TLS certificate validation will not be disabled.
redirect_downgrade: Refusing a redirect that downgrades HTTPS to HTTP.
http_error: Apple endpoint {host} returned HTTP {status}. This version may be unavailable, or the service may require another documented selector.
tls_error: TLS certificate verification failed for {host}. No certificate checks were disabled.
network_error: Could not contact {host} after the configured retries.
response_large: The metadata response exceeds the allowed size.
invalid_selector: Invalid recovery board, serial template or request type.
apple_response: Apple returned incomplete or invalid recovery metadata.
range_error: The server returned an inconsistent byte range. Refusing to append data.
download_interrupted: Download remains incomplete. Run the same command again to resume: {path}
missing_tool: Required tool not found: {tool}. Use --install-deps or install Debian packages xorriso and 7zip.
tool_timeout: The {tool} operation exceeded its time limit.
version_unreadable: Cannot read SystemVersion.plist from this verified image. Use current Debian 7zip with DMG/HFS+/APFS support; no ISO will be mislabeled.
iso_layout: The ISO does not have the expected ISO9660/APM/HFS+ recovery layout.
iso_extra_boot: Unexpected embedded boot image. This builder uses a separate OpenCore EFI.
iso_extra_file: Unexpected or ambiguous file in the HFS+ boot volume: {path}
iso_payload_mismatch: The ISO's boot-volume payload or metadata differs from the verified recovery source.
invalid_arguments: These operation options cannot be combined. Use --help to select one operation.
dry_run_local: Plan only: verify the local signed recovery for {name}, inspect its version, and create a Recovery ISO in {output}, using temporary files in {work}. No network request or ISO creation performed.
input_file: Input file does not exist or is not a regular file: {path}
work_outside: Temporary data must remain inside this project's _/temp directory: {path}
output_outside: The output directory must be inside the project. Move the whole tool folder to the desired storage if needed: {path}
unsupported_platform: This builder targets Linux/Debian with Python 3.13 or newer.
invalid_limits: Use a timeout between 5 and 300 seconds and between 1 and 8 retries.
deps_unavailable: Automatic dependency installation requires Debian's apt-get and root or sudo.
deps_failed: Dependency installation failed. Install xorriso and 7zip, then rerun the command.
full_not_supported: A full offline installer is not produced by this Debian-native workflow. It creates signed recovery media; Apple's createinstallmedia needs macOS.
selection_failed: None of the documented selectors produced the requested version. Last result: {message}
help_os: macOS family/name, or an exact point version to enforce (for example 26, Tahoe, 10.7.5)
help_list: list all version families and availability limitations
help_doctor: check local dependencies and free space
help_verify: independently verify an ISO's actual HFS+ Apple payload and version
help_image: use an already downloaded, signed recovery DMG
help_output: output directory inside the project (default: ISOs)
help_install: allow installation of missing xorriso/7zip packages via apt
help_noninteractive: do not ask questions; require a version or explicit operation
help_https: reject Apple's legacy HTTP asset URLs; never disable TLS checks
help_timeout: network timeout per operation, in seconds (default: 45)
help_dry: show the selected build plan without accessing the network
help_json: print structured JSON for list, probe, doctor or final results
help_probe: request metadata and verify the chunklist without downloading the image
help_full: explicitly reject unsupported full offline creation instead of silently substituting recovery
group_powerpc: Older PowerPC systems: original media required
group_latest: Ask Apple for its latest Intel recovery
